topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a folded paper tucked away in a drawer, its edges slightly worn. It was my partner's bucket list. My eyes scanned the neatly written goals—some whimsical, others profound. I wanted to respect their privacy, but the curiosity was too much. Each item offered a glimpse into their dreams, and I found myself wishing I could share in them. I quietly put the list back, hoping it would remain a secret that I'd seen it, unsure of what to do now that I know these private aspirations.
